issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): delete_paths_in_background unused-public in _linked_repo_workspaces.py
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** just _lint-symvision

Found while splitting src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_agent_enter_targets.py into focused modules. After the split, just _lint-symvision fails with 'Unused public functions/classes: delete_paths_in_background in src/sase/_linked_repo_workspaces.py'. The symbol is used only within its defining file (lines 94, 117, 122, 128), so per sase memory symvision.md it should be made private.

Verified pre-existing and unrelated to the split: stashed all split changes (git stash -u) and re-ran just _lint-symvision on the pristine tree at 18b8a7bd0798e7b52cfa0622d801e49e471d2a5a -- same failure. Do NOT fix by deleting the symbol; it has live in-file callers.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic lint-gate failure reproduced on the pristine tree with split changes stashed; fails identically with and without the split, so it is not intermittent and not caused by the split.

evidence.note: sase-16k land agent reproduced at master d21b9453e: sase tool run check (run 2a16ffe8176d7a748b193c66b8a07776) fails lint (symvision) with only 'delete_paths_in_background in src/sase/_linked_repo_workspaces.py'. Root cause: 505934a63 (sase-16e.3) renamed _delete_paths_in_background to public while every caller stays in-file. Blocks just check for every agent.

Independent reproduction during enter_project_workflow_child_patch implementation (2026-09-22): sase tool run check fails lint (symvision) with only 'delete_paths_in_background in src/sase/_linked_repo_workspaces.py'. Verified pre-existing: git stash of all implementation changes then direct symvision re-run on pristine tree at d40c759db shows the identical failure; popped stash after. Unrelated to the _patch_navigation.py fix.
